In a titration, why is distilled water and not tap water used to rinse the burette?
A
Distilled water contains more bacteria than tap water.
B
Distilled water contains fewer dissolved ions than tap water.
C
Distilled water dissolves substances better than tap water.
D
Distilled water has been filtered and tap water has not.

options.label: A
options.text: Distilled water contains more bacteria than tap water.

options.label: B
options.text: Distilled water contains fewer dissolved ions than tap water.

options.label: C
options.text: Distilled water dissolves substances better than tap water.
